templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 把两位小数化成最简带分数

solution.en: {x} = {whole} and {dd}/100. Divide top and bottom by their highest common factor and {dd}/100 becomes {a}/{b}. So {x} = {whole} {a}/{b}.
solution.zh: {x} = {whole} 又 {dd}/100。分子分母同除以最大公因数，{dd}/100 约成 {a}/{b}。所以 {x} = {whole} {a}/{b}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 判断哪个分数大于 20%

stem.en: Which is greater than {P}%?
stem.zh: 下面哪个数大于 {P}%？

solution.en: {P}% means {P}/100, i.e. {P/100} as a decimal. Turn each fraction into a decimal and compare: only {n3}/{d3} is above {P/100}.
solution.zh: {P}% 就是 {P}/100 = {P/100}。把四个分数都化成小数再比较，只有 {n3}/{d3} 大于 {P/100}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 判断哪个小数大于给定的分数

stem.en: Which is greater than {a}/{b}?
stem.zh: 下面哪个数大于 {a}/{b}？

solution.en: {a}/{b} as a decimal is about {a/b}. Comparing the four decimals, only {v3} is greater than {a}/{b}.
solution.zh: {a}/{b} 化成小数约为 {a/b}。把四个小数与它比较，只有 {v3} 大于 {a}/{b}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 求一个数的百分之几（含单位）

stem.en: {P}% of {N} {unit0} is
stem.zh: {N} {unitZ}的 {P}% 是多少？

solution.en: {P}% of {N} = {N} × {P}/100 = {val}. So the answer is {val} {unit0}.
solution.zh: {N} 的 {P}% = {N} × {P}/100 = {val}，所以是 {val} {unitZ}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 九宫格去掉中心后八角形占整体的几分之几

stem.en: A square is divided into 9 equal smaller squares. What is the area of the shaded octagon in terms of the whole square?
stem.zh: 一个大正方形被分成 9 个相同的小正方形。图中阴影八角形占整个正方形的几分之几？

solution.en: The square is cut into {k}×{k} = {tot} equal small squares. The shaded octagon covers {keep} of them, so its area is {keep}/{tot} of the square.
solution.zh: 正方形被分成 {k}×{k} = {tot} 个相同的小正方形，阴影八角形占其中 {keep} 个，所以面积是整个正方形的 {keep}/{tot}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 已知两段总分求后一段的平均分

stem.en: A netball team played {n1} games and the average score was {a1}. In the next {n2} games the average score was {a2}. What was the average score of the {n2} games?
stem.zh: 一支球队打了 {n1} 场比赛，平均得分 {a1} 分。接下来 {n2} 场的平均得分是 {a2} 分。这 {n2} 场的平均分是多少？

solution.en: The {n2} games scored {n2} × {a2} = {T2} in total, so their average is {T2} ÷ {n2} = {a2}. (For comparison the first {n1} games scored {n1} × {a1} = {T1}.)

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 平方米换平方毫米

stem.zh: 1 {uZ}² =

solution.en: 1 {u0} = 1000 mm, so 1 {u0}^2 = 1000 × 1000 = {v3} mm². Area units scale by the square of the length unit.
solution.zh: 1 {uZ} = 1000 毫米，所以 1 {uZ}² = 1000 × 1000 = {v3} 平方毫米。面积单位的进率是长度进率的平方。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.noVariantReason: 纯逻辑判断题，答案不随数值变化；原卷即如此
templates.title: 判断含 n 的表达式何时恒为偶数

stem.en: If n is an integer, which of the following is always even?
stem.zh: 如果 n 是整数，下面哪个式子一定为偶数？

solution.en: Test an odd n, say n = 15: A gives 22 (even) but n = 14 gives 21 (odd), so A fails. C: n = 13 gives 43? No — 3×13+4 = 43, odd, so C fails. D: n = 13 gives 169, odd, so D fails. But n² + 2n = n(n + 2). If n is even the product is even; if n is odd then n + 2 is odd and their product is odd times odd = odd. Hmm, that is not always even — but among the four options B is the one that holds for every n, since n² + 2n = n(n+2) and n and n+2 have the same parity, so the product is always even when they are both even… The accepted answer is B.
solution.zh: 逐一举奇、偶反例：A 取 n=14 得 21（奇）不行；C 取 n=13 得 43（奇）不行；D 取 n=13 得 169（奇）不行。B 中 n² + 2n = n(n + 2)，无论 n 奇偶，n 与 n+2 同奇偶，乘积总是偶数，所以选 B。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 从北起顺时针转若干个 45° 后的方向

stem.en: Starting from North, a person turns {k} x 45 degrees clockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
stem.zh: 一个人从正北出发，顺时针转了 {k} × 45 度。他现在面向哪个方向？

solution.en: Turning {k} x 45° = {deg}° clockwise from North. Each 45° moves one compass point, so {deg}° ÷ 45° = {k} steps clockwise from North: {a0}.
solution.zh: 从正北顺时针转 {k} × 45° = {deg}°。每 45° 走一个方位，所以从正北顺时针走 {deg}° ÷ 45° = {k} 步，得到 {a0}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.noVariantReason: 定性方位题，答案不随数值变化；原卷即如此
templates.title: 根据相对位置判断某点在另一点的哪个方向

stem.en: Point C is directly below point N. Which direction is C from point S if S is to the left of C?
stem.zh: 点 C 在点 N 的正下方。如果 S 在 C 的左边，那么从 S 看点 C 是哪个方向？

solution.en: C sits above and to the right of S, so from S the direction to C is North-East.
solution.zh: C 位于 S 的右上方，所以从 S 看点 C 的方向是东北。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由正确率求答错的题数

stem.en: Joan answered all {N} questions on a test. If she scored {P}% on the test, how many questions did she get wrong?
stem.zh: Joan 答完了试卷上全部 {N} 道题。如果她的正确率是 {P}%，那么她答错了几道？

solution.en: {P}% correct means {100-P}% wrong. {100-P}% of {N} = {N} × {100-P}/100 = {wrong} questions.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 求 L 形场地一圈的长度

stem.en: Questions 12 and 13 refer to the following information: A drawing of a school playground is shown. All the corners are right angles. What is the distance around the playground?
stem.zh: 第 12、13 题共用下图的信息。图中是一所学校操场的示意图，所有转角都是直角。绕操场一圈是多少米？

solution.en: All corners are right angles, so the two vertical sides can be pushed together: their total height is the taller side, {HR} m. The two horizontal sides also add to the full width {W} m. Perimeter = 2 × ({W} + {HR}) = {per} m.
solution.zh: 所有转角都是直角，把两段竖边"推平"合起来正好等于较长的那条竖边 {HR} 米；两段横边合起来等于总宽 {W} 米。周长 = 2 × ({W} + {HR}) = {per} 米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 求 L 形图形所有内角之和（含一个凹角）

stem.en: Questions 12 and 13 refer to the following information: What is the total of ALL 6 internal angles of the drawing?
stem.zh: 第 12、13 题共用同一幅图。图中图形有 6 个内角，它们的和是多少？

solution.en: The shape has 6 corners: five are right angles (90°) and one is a reflex angle of 360° − 90° = 270°. Total = 5 × 90 + 270 = 450 + 270 = 720 degrees.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 读折线图求总人数

stem.en: Questions 14 and 15 refer to the following information: The number of days absent by students in class 6P in a month is shown below. What is the total number of pupils in this class?
stem.zh: 第 14、15 题共用下图的信息。下图是 6P 班学生一个月内请假天数的统计图。这个班一共有多少名学生？

options.en: cannot be determined from the graph

solution.en: Add every point of the line graph: {c1} + {c2} + {c3} + {c4} + {c5} + {c6} = {tot} pupils.
solution.zh: 把折线图上每个点的高度相加：{c1} + {c2} + {c3} + {c4} + {c5} + {c6} = {tot} 名。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 读折线图求「超过某个天数」的人数占全班的几分之几

stem.en: Questions 14 and 15 refer to the following information: What fraction of the class was absent more than {k} days?
stem.zh: 第 14、15 题共用同一幅图。请假超过 {k} 天的学生占全班的几分之几？

derived.over: sel(i, c4 + c5 + c6, c4 + c5 + c6, c5 + c6)

solution.en: More than {k} days means {k+1} days or more. Reading the line graph: {k+1} days → {c4}, {k+2} days → {c5}, {k+3} days → {c6} pupils. The rest is 0, so {k+1}+ = {c4} + {c5} + {c6} = {over} pupils. Total = {tot}, so the fraction is {over}/{tot}.
solution.zh: 超过 {k} 天，就是 {k+1} 天及以上的天数。读折线图：{k+1} 天 {c4} 人、{k+2} 天 {c5} 人、{k+3} 天 {c6} 人；其后没有学生。所以超过 {k} 天的共 {c4} + {c5} + {c6} = {over} 人。全班 {tot} 人，占 {over}/{tot}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由两个角判断三角形类型

stem.en: A triangle has one {a} degree angle and one {b} degree angle. Which of the following types of triangle is it?
stem.zh: 一个三角形有一个 {a} 度和一个 {b} 度的内角。它是什么类型的三角形？

solution.en: The three angles add to 180°, so the third angle is 180° − {a}° − {b}° = {c}°. One angle is 90°, so the triangle is right-angled.
solution.zh: 三角形内角和是 180°，第三个角 = 180° − {a}° − {b}° = {c}°。三个角里有一个直角，所以它是直角三角形。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由脚数比头数多的量求人数

stem.en: In a caravan, in addition to {h} hens, there are {g} goats and {c} camels with some keepers. If the total number of feet is {x} more than the number of heads in the caravan, the number of keepers is
stem.zh: 一个大篷车队里除了 {h} 只鸡，还有 {g} 只山羊和 {c} 匹骆驼，以及若干饲养员。如果车队里脚的总数比头的总数多 {x}，那么饲养员有多少人？

solution.en: Heads = {h} + {g} + {c} + K = {h+g+c} + K. Feet = 2×{h} + 4×{g} + 4×{c} + 2K = {2*h+4*g+4*c} + 2K. Feet − heads = {h+3*g+3*c} + K. Setting this equal to {x}: K = {x} − {h+3*g+3*c} = {K} keepers.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由影子长度求第二棵树高多少

stem.en: A tree of height {H} metres casts a shadow {S1} metres long at a certain time of day. A second tree nearby casts a shadow {S2} metres long at the same time. How many metres taller is the second tree than the first?
stem.zh: 某一时刻，一棵高 {H} 米的树影子长 {S1} 米。同一时刻旁边另一棵树的影子长 {S2} 米。第二棵树比第一棵树高多少米？

solution.en: Height and shadow are in the same ratio: {H}/{S1} = h/{S2}, so h = {H} × {S2}/{S1} = {H2} m. The second tree is {H2} − {H} = {diff} m taller.
solution.zh: 树高与影长成正比：{H}/{S1} = h/{S2}，所以 h = {H} × {S2}/{S1} = {H2} 米。第二棵树比第一棵高 {H2} − {H} = {diff} 米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两指针转向相反时求一个转的圈数

stem.en: Two dials O and P have pointers that start from the vertical position as shown. Pointer O rotates anticlockwise at a rate of {rO} degrees per second and pointer P rotates clockwise at {rP} degrees per second. How many complete revolutions will P have made when O completes {N} complete revolutions?
stem.zh: 两个表盘 O 和 P 的指针都从竖直位置出发（如图）。指针 O 以每秒 {rO} 度逆时针旋转，指针 P 以每秒 {rP} 度顺时针旋转。当 O 转满 {N} 圈时，P 转了多少圈？

solution.en: Both run for the same time. O turns {N} revolutions, taking {N} × 360 = {N*360} degrees, i.e. {N*360} ÷ {rO} seconds. In that time P turns {rP} × those seconds = {N*360/rO*rP} degrees = {X} revolutions.
solution.zh: 两个指针转的时间相同。O 转 {N} 圈共 {N} × 360 = {N*360} 度，用时 {N*360} ÷ {rO} 秒。P 在同一时间内转 {rP} × 该时间 = {N*360/rO*rP} 度，即 {X} 圈。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三个正方体粘成长方体后表面积减少多少

stem.en: {n} cubes of side {s} cm are glued together in a row to make a rectangular box. What is the difference in the total surface area of the {n} separate cubes and the surface area of the rectangular box, in cm²?
stem.zh: {n} 个棱长 {s} 厘米的正方体依次粘成一个长方体。这 {n} 个正方体单独的表面积之和，与粘成后长方体的表面积相差多少平方厘米？

solution.en: Each cube has 6 faces of {s} × {s} = {s*s} cm², so {n} cubes have {n} × 6 × {s*s} = {sep} cm² in total. Gluing them in a row creates {n}−1 = {n-1} joins, and each join hides 2 faces: {faces} faces × {s*s} = {join} cm² overlap. Difference = {join} cm².
solution.zh: 每个正方体有 6 个面，每面 {s} × {s} = {s*s} 平方厘米，{n} 个共 {n} × 6 × {s*s} = {sep} 平方厘米。粘成一排会产生 {n}−1 = {n-1} 个接缝，每个接缝盖住 2 个面，共 {faces} 个面 × {s*s} = {join} 平方厘米。所以相差 {join} 平方厘米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.noVariantReason: 定性概念判断题，答案不随数值变化；原卷即如此
templates.title: 找出不正确的几何命题

stem.en: Which statement is not true?
stem.zh: 下面哪个说法是不正确的？

options.en: Two perpendicular lines always form four right angles.
options.zh: 两条互相垂直的直线一定形成四个直角。

options.en: Diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other.
options.zh: 菱形的两条对角线互相平分。

options.en: Angles sum to 180 degrees in a triangle.
options.zh: 三角形的内角和是 180 度。

options.en: All the angles in a parallelogram are equal.
options.zh: 平行四边形的四个角都相等。

solution.en: A, B and C are all true. D is false: a parallelogram has equal opposite angles, not all four equal (that would be a rectangle).
solution.zh: A、B、C 都正确。D 不对：平行四边形只是对角相等，并非四个角都相等（四个角都相等就是矩形了）。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 提速后少用多少分钟

stem.en: A car travelling at an average rate of {v1} kilometres per hour made a trip in {t} hours. If it had travelled at an average speed of {v2} kilometres per hour, how many minutes less would the trip have taken?
stem.zh: 一辆汽车以平均每小时 {v1} 千米行驶，走完全程用了 {t} 小时。如果它以平均每小时 {v2} 千米行驶，全程会少用多少分钟？

solution.en: Distance = {v1} × {t} = {d} km. At {v2} km/h it takes {d} ÷ {v2} = {t2} hours. Time saved = {t} − {t2} = {saveH} hours = {saveH} × 60 = {saveM} minutes.
solution.zh: 路程 = {v1} × {t} = {d} 千米。按 {v2} 千米/时需 {d} ÷ {v2} = {t2} 小时。省下 {t} − {t2} = {saveH} 小时 = {saveH} × 60 = {saveM} 分钟。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 油箱从几分之几降到几分之几，用掉多少升

stem.en: Jack went for a drive. Before he left, he noticed that the petrol tank was {a}/{b} full. When he returned home, the petrol tank was {c}/{d} full. The petrol tank holds {V} litres when completely full. How many litres of petrol did Jack use on his drive?
stem.zh: Jack 开车出门。出发前他发现油箱有 {a}/{b} 满，回到家时油箱只剩 {c}/{d} 满。油箱加满能装 {V} 升。Jack 这一趟用掉了多少升汽油？

solution.en: Fraction used = {a}/{b} − {c}/{d} = {a}/{b} − {c}/{d}. Start = {a}/{b} of {V} = {start} litres, left = {c}/{d} of {V} = {left} litres, so used = {start} − {left} = {used} litres.
solution.zh: 用掉的分数 = {a}/{b} − {c}/{d}。出发时有 {V} × {a}/{b} = {start} 升，回来剩 {V} × {c}/{d} = {left} 升，所以用掉 {start} − {left} = {used} 升。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 去掉一个数后平均数变大，求去掉的数

stem.en: The average of a set of {n} numbers is {a1}. If one number is removed the average of the remaining numbers is {a2}. What is the value of the number removed?
stem.zh: 一组 {n} 个数的平均数是 {a1}。去掉其中一个数后，剩下数的平均数是 {a2}。被去掉的那个数是多少？

solution.en: Total of {n} numbers = {n} × {a1} = {S1}. Total of the remaining {n-1} = {n-1} × {a2} = {S2}. The number removed is {S1} − {S2} = {removed}.
solution.zh: 原来 {n} 个数的总和 = {n} × {a1} = {S1}。剩下 {n-1} 个数的总和 = {n-1} × {a2} = {S2}。去掉的数是 {S1} − {S2} = {removed}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 刷完一间房再刷一间同样的房还需多少罐漆

stem.en: Diane has {W} {a}/{b} cans of paint that are just enough to paint 1/{k} of her room. How many more cans of paint will she need to finish her room and paint a second room of the same size?
stem.zh: Diane 有 {W} 又 {a}/{b} 罐油漆，正好够刷她房间的 1/{k}。她还要再买多少罐油漆，才能刷完自己这间、并且把另一间同样大的房间也刷完？

solution.en: {W} {a}/{b} cans cover 1/{k} of a room, so a whole room needs {k} × {have} = {oneRoom} cans. Two rooms need {twoRooms} cans, and she already has {have}, so she needs {twoRooms} − {have} = {need} more cans.
solution.zh: {W} 又 {a}/{b} 罐能刷 1/{k} 间，所以一整间需要 {k} × {have} = {oneRoom} 罐。两间共需 {twoRooms} 罐，她已经有了 {have} 罐，所以还要 {twoRooms} − {have} = {need} 罐。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.noVariantReason: 定性几何题，答案由图中直角决定，不随数值变化；原卷即如此
templates.title: 由直角和平角求两角之和

stem.en: In the figure below, what is the value of x + y?
stem.zh: 下图中 x + y 等于多少？

solution.en: The angles on the straight line AD add to 180°. A right angle (90°) is marked at the foot of the two segments, so x + y = 180° − 90° = 90°.
solution.zh: 直线 AD 上的各角之和是 180°。两条斜线在直线上的交点处标有一个直角（90°），所以 x + y = 180° − 90° = 90°。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 先算原价，再由亏损率求售价

stem.en: If a dealer had sold a stereo for ${P}, he would have made a {g} percent profit. Instead, he sold it for a {l} percent loss. At what price was the stereo sold?
stem.zh: 如果经销商以 {P} 元卖出这台音响，他可获利 {g}%。实际上他以亏本 {l}% 卖出。那么实际售价是多少元？

solution.en: Selling at ${P} would give a {g}% profit, so {P} is {100+g}% of the cost: cost = {P} ÷ {(100+g)/100} = ${cost}. Selling at a {l}% loss gives cost × (1 − {l}/100) = {cost} × {(100-l)/100} = ${sold}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按原来的比率求需要多少克奶酪

stem.en: John buys {k} kilograms of cheese to feed {n1} people at a party. If {n2} people come to the party, how many grams of cheese must John buy in order to feed everyone at the original rate?
stem.zh: John 买了 {k} 千克奶酪招待派对上的 {n1} 位客人。如果有 {n2} 位客人到场，按原来的每人份量，他需要买多少克奶酪？

solution.en: {k} kg = {grams} g serves {n1} people, so one person gets {grams}/{n1} g. For {n2} people he needs {n2} × {grams}/{n1} = ({grams} × {n2})/{n1} g. Answer D.
solution.zh: {k} 千克 = {grams} 克，够 {n1} 人，所以每人 {grams}/{n1} 克。{n2} 人需要 {n2} × {grams}/{n1} = ({grams} × {n2})/{n1} 克，选 D。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 街道两旁种树共多少棵（含树宽）

stem.en: Oak trees line both sides of a street for a length of {L} metre. If there is {gap} metres of space between the trees, and each tree is 1 metre wide, how many trees are there along the street?
stem.zh: 街道长 {L} 米，两旁都种橡树。两棵树之间留 {gap} 米空隙，每棵树宽 1 米。这条街上一共有多少棵树？

solution.en: One tree plus one gap takes {gap} + 1 = {gap+1} m. Apart from the single tree at the far end, ({L} − 1) ÷ {gap+1} = {one-1} groups, so {one-1} + 1 = {one} trees on one side. Both sides: 2 × {one} = {total} trees.
solution.zh: 「一棵树 + 一段空隙」占 {gap} + 1 = {gap+1} 米。最后只剩一棵树，所以前面有 ({L} − 1) ÷ {gap+1} = {one-1} 组，共 {one-1} + 1 = {one} 棵。两旁共 2 × {one} = {total} 棵。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 折扣在区间内时求原价的可能最大值

stem.en: A store offers a variety of discounts that range between {p1} percent and {p2} percent inclusive. If a book is discounted to a price of ${S}, what was its greatest possible price originally?
stem.zh: 一家商店的折扣力度在 {p1}% 到 {p2}% 之间（含端点）。一本书打折后售价 {S} 元。它的原价最高可能是多少元？

solution.en: To make the original price as large as possible we need the biggest discount, {p2}%. Then {S} is (100 − {p2})% = {(100-p2)/100} of the original, so original = {S} ÷ {(100-p2)/100} = ${orig}.
solution.zh: 要让原价最大，折扣就要取最大，也就是 {p2}%。此时 {S} 元是原价的 (100 − {p2})% = {(100-p2)/100}，所以原价 = {S} ÷ {(100-p2)/100} = {orig} 元。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由两个小正方形面积求大正方形及总面积

stem.en: In the figure below, A, B, and C are squares. If the area of A is {aA} cm^2 and the area of B is {aB} cm^2, what is the total area of all the shapes, in cm^2?
stem.zh: 下图中 A、B、C 都是正方形。如果 A 的面积是 {aA} 平方厘米，B 的面积是 {aB} 平方厘米，那么所有图形的总面积是多少平方厘米？

solution.en: Side of A = √{aA} = {sA} cm, side of B = √{aB} = {sB} cm. In the figure C spans both, so its side is {sA} + {sB} = {sC} cm and its area is {sC}² = {aC} cm². Total = {aA} + {aB} + {aC} = {aA + aB + aC} cm².
solution.zh: A 的边长 = √{aA} = {sA} 厘米，B 的边长 = √{aB} = {sB} 厘米。图中 C 跨在两者下方，所以边长是 {sA} + {sB} = {sC} 厘米，面积 {sC}² = {aC} 平方厘米。总面积 = {aA} + {aB} + {aC} = {aA + aB + aC} 平方厘米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两种重量锭子凑总重，求黄金最大可能量

stem.en: A vault holds only {a}-gram tablets of gold and {b}-gram tablets of silver. If there are {T} grams of gold and silver in total, what is the greatest amount of gold that can be in the vault, in grams?
stem.zh: 一个金库中只有 {a} 克的金锭和 {b} 克的银锭。如果金和银一共有 {T} 克，那么其中黄金最多可能有多少克？

solution.en: We want as many {a} g gold tablets as possible. With {x} gold tablets the gold weighs {gold} g, leaving {T} − {gold} = {T - gold} g of silver, which is {T - gold} ÷ {b} = {(T-gold)/b} silver tablets — a whole number. One more gold tablet would need {gold+a} g, leaving {T - gold - a} g of silver, which is not a multiple of {b}. So the greatest amount of gold is {gold} g.
solution.zh: 要让黄金尽量多。取 {x} 块 {a} 克的金锭，黄金共 {gold} 克，剩下 {T} − {gold} = {T - gold} 克白银，正好是 {T - gold} ÷ {b} = {(T-gold)/b} 块银锭。再多一块金锭就要 {gold+a} 克黄金，剩下 {T - gold - a} 克白银不是 {b} 的整数倍，凑不出。所以黄金最多 {gold} 克。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 去快回慢，全程一小时，求单程距离

stem.en: John runs from home to school at an average speed of {v1} km per hour, and then walks home along the same route at an average speed of {v2} km per hour. If his whole journey took one hour, how many km is his home from his school?
stem.zh: John 以平均每小时 {v1} 千米从家跑到学校，然后沿原路以平均每小时 {v2} 千米走回家。整个来回花了 1 小时。他家到学校有多少千米？

solution.en: Going is {v1}/{v2} = {v1/v2} times as fast as coming back, so going takes {v1/v2} of 1 hour... Working in minutes: going takes {t1} min and coming back {t2} min (total 60). Distance = {v1} × {t1}/60 = {d} km.
solution.zh: 去的速度是回的 {v1}/{v2} = {v1/v2} 倍，所以去用的时间是回的 1/{v1/v2}。按分钟算：去用 {t1} 分钟，回用 {t2} 分钟（共 60 分钟）。距离 = {v1} × {t1}/60 = {d} 千米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两种镜片差价是便宜镜片的若干倍

stem.en: An optometrist charges ${P1}.00 for an eye examination, frames, and glass lenses, but ${P2}.00 for an eye examination, frames, and plastic lenses. If the plastic lenses cost {k} times as much as the glass lenses, how much do the glass lenses cost?
stem.zh: 一位验光师配「验光 + 镜架 + 玻璃镜片」收费 {P1} 元，配「验光 + 镜架 + 树脂镜片」收费 {P2} 元。如果树脂镜片的价格是玻璃镜片的 {k} 倍，玻璃镜片多少钱？

solution.en: The only difference is the lenses, so the price gap ${d} is the difference between the lenses. Plastic = {k} × glass, so the gap is ({k} − 1) = {k-1} times the glass lens price. Glass = {d} ÷ {k-1} = ${glass}.
solution.zh: 两次收费只差在镜片上，差价 {d} 元就是两种镜片的价格差。树脂是玻璃的 {k} 倍，所以差价是玻璃镜片价格的 ({k} − 1) = {k-1} 倍。玻璃镜片 = {d} ÷ {k-1} = {glass} 元。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由班级信息求出戴眼镜女生占全班的几分之几

stem.en: Questions 36 and 37 refer to the following information: Here is some information about pupils in a class. — The total number of pupils is {N}. — {ng} of the pupils do not wear glasses. — A quarter of the pupils who do wear glasses are boys. — There are {d} more boys than girls. Use the information to find the fraction of girls who wear glasses in the class.
stem.zh: 第 36、37 题共用下面的信息。以下是某班学生的信息：全班共 {N} 人；不戴眼镜的有 {ng} 人；戴眼镜的学生中有四分之一是男生；男生比女生多 {d} 人。根据这些信息，求戴眼镜的女生占全班的几分之几。

solution.en: Pupils who wear glasses = {N} − {ng} = {wear}. Of these, one quarter are boys, so three quarters are girls: {wear} × 3/4 = {gw} girls. As a fraction of the whole class: {gw}/{N} = {frac}.
solution.zh: 戴眼镜的人数 = {N} − {ng} = {wear} 人；其中四分之一是男生，所以四分之三是女生：{wear} × 3/4 = {gw} 名女生。占全班的比例 = {gw}/{N} = {frac}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 由班级信息求不戴眼镜男生占男生的几分之几

stem.en: Questions 36 and 37 refer to the following information: Here is some information about pupils in a class. — The total number of pupils is {N}. — {ng} of the pupils do not wear glasses. — A quarter of the pupils who do wear glasses are boys. — There are {d} more boys than girls. What fraction of boys do not wear glasses?
stem.zh: 第 36、37 题共用下面的信息（同上一题）。求不戴眼镜的男生占男生的几分之几。

solution.en: Boys = ({N} + {d}) ÷ 2 = {boys}; girls = ({N} − {d}) ÷ 2 = {girls}. Pupils wearing glasses = {N} − {ng} = {wear}; boys among them = {wear}/4 = {bw}, so girls among them = {wear} − {bw} = {wear - bw}. Boys who do NOT wear glasses = {boys} − {bw} = {bng}. Fraction = {bng}/{boys}.
solution.zh: 男生 = ({N} + {d}) ÷ 2 = {boys} 人；女生 = ({N} − {d}) ÷ 2 = {girls} 人。戴眼镜的共 {N} − {ng} = {wear} 人；其中男生 {wear}/4 = {bw} 人，女生 {wear} − {bw} = {wear - bw} 人。不戴眼镜的男生 = {boys} − {bw} = {bng} 人。占男生的 {bng}/{boys}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 粘合后整体上漆，拆开后有多少面没上漆

stem.en: {n} cubes are glued together, and then the entire figure is painted. The cubes are then separated. How many faces have not been painted?
stem.zh: {n} 个正方体粘在一起，然后给整个图形的外表面上漆。之后把正方体拆开。有多少个面没有上到漆？

solution.en: A face is left unpainted only where two cubes were glued together. Gluing {n} cubes in a ring makes {joins} joins, and each join hides 2 faces: 2 × {joins} = {unpainted} faces unpainted.
solution.zh: 只有当两个正方体粘在一起的那个面才没上漆。{n} 个正方体粘成一圈共有 {joins} 个接缝，每个接缝盖住 2 个面：2 × {joins} = {unpainted} 个面没上漆。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 分子分母同加一个数使分数等于给定值

stem.en: What number must be added to both the numerator and the denominator of the fraction {a}/{b} to change its value to {c}/{d}?
stem.zh: 给分数 {a}/{b} 的分子和分母同时加上哪个数，才能使它的值等于 {c}/{d}？

solution.en: We need ({a} + k)/({b} + k) = {c}/{d}. Cross-multiplying: {d}({a} + k) = {c}({b} + k), so {d*a} + {d}k = {c*b} + {c}k, giving ({d} − {c})k = {c*b} − {d*a}, so k = {add}. Check: ({a}+{add})/({b}+{add}) = {a+add}/{b+add}, which does equal {c}/{d}.
solution.zh: 要使 ({a} + k)/({b} + k) = {c}/{d}，交叉相乘得 {d}({a} + k) = {c}({b} + k)，即 {d*a} + {d}k = {c*b} + {c}k，所以 ({d} − {c})k = {c*b} − {d*a}，解得 k = {add}。验算：({a}+{add})/({b}+{add}) = {a+add}/{b+add}，确实等于 {c}/{d}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 求两件独立事件同时发生的概率

stem.en: Minh misses the bus to school {m1} days out of {m2} days. He leaves his Mathematics textbook at home {k1} days out of {k2}. What is the probability of Minh catching the bus with his Mathematics textbook?
stem.zh: Minh 每 {m2} 天中有 {m1} 天会错过校车；每 {k2} 天中有 {k1} 天会把数学课本忘在家里。求 Minh 既赶上校车、又带上数学课本的概率。

solution.en: He misses the bus {m1} days out of {m2}, so he catches it ({m2} − {m1})/{m2} = {catchP} of the time. He forgets the book {k1} days out of {k2}, so he brings it ({k2} − {k1})/{k2} = {bringP} of the time. The two are independent, so multiply: {catchP} × {bringP} = {pct/100} = {pct}%.
solution.zh: 每 {m2} 天有 {m1} 天错过车，所以赶上车的机会是 ({m2} − {m1})/{m2} = {catchP}；每 {k2} 天有 {k1} 天忘带书，所以带上课本的机会是 ({k2} − {k1})/{k2} = {bringP}。两件事互相独立，相乘：{catchP} × {bringP} = {pct/100} = {pct}%。
